summary: A join may evaluate a raising conjunct only on pairs that pass the other conjuncts: such pairs are in no allowed result, so by D16 the engine may return there; the split of a mixed residual is admitted. No D-number; a dated note goes under D19.
note: Addendum to ruling 162; amends its P2 (cross join plus filter for 'any other residual'). J1-J5 and J7 lapse with the swap's withdrawal (F164.A1); the principle stands with no user.
